title: Rate limiting at the API boundary
purpose: Show middleware's atomic shared-state check, allowed API path and explicit 429 rejection response.
alt: 레디스 상태를 원자적으로 확인·갱신하는 처리율 제한 미들웨어와 허용·429 거부 경로
requiredChecks: Request travels Client→Rate-limit middleware and allowed outcome→API servers.
Middleware exchanges an Atomic check/update with Redis shared state before the allow/reject outcome.
Rejected outcome returns HTTP429 Too Many Requests to Client, bypassing API servers.
Redis is counter/timestamp state, not a substitute API server; no non-atomic read-then-update race is depicted.
